subject: [PATCH 3/6] NFSD: Document per-export riomode= and wiomode= options

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch documents two new export options for the NFS server: riomode= and wiomode=. These options allow users to set the I/O mode independently for each export, overriding global settings. The options accept values of buffered, dontcache, or direct, with the same meanings as their corresponding debugfs values.
